dedupe_keys.name: telecommunication authority of fiji quarterly country wide telecom indicator reports 2018 to 2024

description: The Telecommunication Authority of Fiji publishes quarterly country-wide reports of telecommunication indicators. The page lists 27 reports from January to March 2018 to July to September 2024. Each one-page report gives the ITU core indicators for the quarter, for example for July to September 2024: fixed telephone subscriptions of 17.66 per 100 people, mobile cellular subscriptions of 542.23 per 100, fixed wired broadband of 1.90 per 100, wireless broadband of 7.66 per 100, active mobile broadband of 151.10 per 100, and international internet bandwidth of 5.30 Mbit/s per 100 people. A companion page explains each indicator. Coverage: Fiji, national by quarter. Format and access: one-page PDF reports on the TAF website, free; no licence is stated. Caveats: ratios only, without absolute counts; the mobile figure far above 100 suggests counting of inactive or multiple SIMs; the series stops at the third quarter of 2024 on the page read. Simulation uses: quarterly demand indicators for Fijian network planning and for tracking the effect of cyclones such as Winston (2016) and Yasa (2020). Related records: data-itu-ict-statistics gives the same indicators annually; data-telegeography-submarine-cable-map shows the Southern Cross and Tonga cable landings in Fiji.
